comment: 30B-A3B MoE qwen3moe 48L 128 experts on MLX weights (4-bit, 17G). Swept 2026-10-10 on M1 Max 64 GB, 128 greedy tokens incl. prefill, each knob its own session, baseline repeated last as drift control (54.2 -> 56.0 prose, so +-2% is noise): baseline prose 54-56 / rep 52.6; prefill 420-470 tok/s (1329-tok prompt in 2.9-3.2 s). mlx_prefix_cache ON: no decode cost (56.4 / 53.0), 1329-tok repeat TTFT 2.9 s -> 39 ms (23 ms under batching). mlx_batch ON: single request at parity (55.9 / 51.6), 4 concurrent 72 tok/s aggregate (1.3x) with worst TTFT 1.4 s. Speculation OFF: the throughput gate parks n-gram drafts at d4 (acc 0.30) and d2 (acc 0.50) on this model, so it is neutral, not a win. KV stays f16: mlx_kv_bits=8 cost 14% (48.1 / 45.7) AND changed the prose output. Every kept knob is byte-identical to the baseline on both prompts. Versus the Metal GGUF recipe (30b.json, 58.2 decode-only in Sep): decode within noise, prefix cache repeat 39 ms vs 620 ms, and this one composes with the pool and continuous batching.

bench.protocol: 128 greedy tokens incl. prefill, median of 3 (prose) / 2 (rep); one session per knob; drift control last
